mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments (order_id, payment_key, amount, member_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{amount}, #{memberId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW());
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET status = #{status}, payment_key = #{paymentKey}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
